title: Urinary incontinence check-in (ICIQ-UI SF)
description: The 4-item International Consultation on Incontinence Questionnaire — Short Form. Validated scale of urinary incontinence frequency, severity, impact on daily life, and circumstance of leakage. Used at baseline for any patient reporting urinary leakage and at 3-month follow-up after pelvic-floor or urogynecologic intervention.

items.text: How often do you leak urine?

options.label: About once a week or less often
Two or three times a week

items.text: How much urine do you usually leak (whether you wear protection or not)?
Overall, how much does leaking urine interfere with your everyday life?
When does urine leak? (Select all that apply.)

options.label: Leaks before you can get to the toilet
Leaks when you cough or sneeze
Leaks when you are physically active / exercising
Leaks when you have finished urinating and are dressed

scoring.note: Sum the numeric values from the first three items (frequency 0–5, amount 0–6, impact 0–10). Range 0–21. The fourth item (when does it leak) is descriptive only and is NOT summed.

thresholds.message: ICIQ-UI SF total ≥13 (severe range). Pelvic-floor evaluation, urodynamic workup, or surgical-management discussion warranted.
ICIQ-UI SF score has worsened by ≥5 points compared to baseline. Recommend earlier follow-up.

citation: Avery K, Donovan J, Peters TJ, Shaw C, Gotoh M, Abrams P. ICIQ: a brief and robust measure for evaluating the symptoms and impact of urinary incontinence. Neurourol Urodyn 2004;23(4):322-30. PMID: 15227649
